data.narrative:
Shine Technologies is a Series E climate and energy company founded by Greg Piefer that has raised over $1.0B to date. The comparable universe includes 1 public peer (LNZA) and 8 private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method given data constraints. Using the $1.0B total capital raised as a valuation proxy, application of a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical for Series E progression yields an implied valuation of $1.4B. This reflects the expected value increase between institutional funding rounds at this stage. Peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient narrowly-filtered comparable data; while 9 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 met strict same-stage and similar-tier filters, making sector-wide medians uninformative.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.2B to $1.6B, with a median point of $1.4B. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the lack of tightly-clustered peer valuations in the frontier-energy subsector and reliance on total-capital-raised as a proxy in the absence of disclosed recent round terms. Additional financial metrics—revenue run-rate, unit economics, or recent interim valuations—would strengthen conviction in this range.
